diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/columns.test-d.ts b/src/components/data-grid/columns.test-d.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f684ee5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/columns.test-d.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+import { expectTypeOf, test } from 'vitest';
+import { dataGridColumn } from './data-grid-column';
+import type {
+  DataGridCellContext,
+  DataGridColumn,
+  DataGridDataType,
+  DataGridFieldColumn,
+  DataGridKey,
+  DataGridPage,
+  DataGridSortDirection,
+  DataGridSortItem,
+  DataGridValueColumn,
+} from './types';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  total: number;
+  placed: string;
+  paid: boolean;
+  qty: number;
+}
+
+// A state type is JSON-only when every property is a JSON value: no function, symbol or Date.
+type IsJson<T> = T extends string | number | boolean | null
+  ? true
+  : T extends readonly (infer U)[]
+    ? IsJson<U>
+    : T extends (...args: never[]) => unknown
+      ? false
+      : T extends object
+        ? { [K in keyof T]: IsJson<T[K]> }[keyof T] extends true
+          ? true
+          : false
+        : false;
+
+test('field takes only the string keys of the row', () => {
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridFieldColumn<Order>['field']>().toEqualTypeOf<keyof Order & string>();
+  const ok: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [{ field: 'total' }, { field: 'placed', caption: 'Placed' }];
+  expectTypeOf(ok).toBeArray();
+  // @ts-expect-error a key the row does not have
+  const unknownField: DataGridColumn<Order> = { field: 'price' };
+  expectTypeOf(unknownField).toBeObject();
+  interface Keyed {
+    1: string;
+    name: string;
+  }
+  // @ts-expect-error a number key is not a string key
+  const numberKey: DataGridColumn<Keyed> = { field: 1 };
+  expectTypeOf(numberKey).toBeObject();
+});
+
+test('the cell and format of a field column take the type of that field', () => {
+  const total: DataGridColumn<Order> = {
+    field: 'total',
+    cell(ctx) {
+      expectTypeOf(ctx.value).toEqualTypeOf<number>();
+      expectTypeOf(ctx.row).toEqualTypeOf<Order>();
+      return ctx.text;
+    },
+    format: (value, row) => {
+      expectTypeOf(value).toEqualTypeOf<number>();
+      expectTypeOf(row).toEqualTypeOf<Order>();
+      return String(value);
+    },
+  };
+  const paid: DataGridColumn<Order> = {
+    field: 'paid',
+    cell: (ctx) => {
+      expectTypeOf(ctx.value).toEqualTypeOf<boolean>();
+      return null;
+    },
+  };
+  expectTypeOf(total).toBeObject();
+  expectTypeOf(paid).toBeObject();
+});
+
+test('a value column needs an id and a value function, and has no field', () => {
+  const ok: DataGridColumn<Order> = { id: 'amount', value: (row) => row.qty * row.total };
+  expectTypeOf(ok).toBeObject();
+  // @ts-expect-error a value column without an id
+  const noId: DataGridColumn<Order> = { value: (row) => row.qty };
+  // @ts-expect-error neither a field nor a value
+  const neither: DataGridColumn<Order> = { id: 'x' };
+  // @ts-expect-error a field and a value together
+  const both: DataGridColumn<Order> = { field: 'qty', id: 'x', value: (row) => row.qty };
+  expectTypeOf(noId).toBeObject();
+  expectTypeOf(neither).toBeObject();
+  expectTypeOf(both).toBeObject();
+});
+
+test('dataGridColumn keeps the value type of a computed column', () => {
+  const amount = dataGridColumn<Order>()({
+    id: 'amount',
+    value: (row) => row.qty * row.total,
+    cell: (ctx) => {
+      expectTypeOf(ctx.value).toEqualTypeOf<number>();
+      return null;
+    },
+    format: (value) => value.toFixed(2),
+  });
+  expectTypeOf(amount).toEqualTypeOf<DataGridValueColumn<Order, number>>();
+  const label = dataGridColumn<Order>()({
+    id: 'label',
+    value: (row) => (row.paid ? 'Paid' : null),
+  });
+  expectTypeOf(label).toEqualTypeOf<DataGridValueColumn<Order, 'Paid' | null>>();
+  // Columns of different value types sit in one list.
+  const columns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [amount, label, { field: 'placed' }];
+  expectTypeOf(columns).toBeArray();
+});
+
+test('dataType accepts the five types and rejects anything else', () => {
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridDataType>().toEqualTypeOf<
+    'string' | 'number' | 'date' | 'datetime' | 'boolean'
+  >();
+  // @ts-expect-error not a type of the grid
+  const money: DataGridColumn<Order> = { field: 'total', dataType: 'money' };
+  expectTypeOf(money).toBeObject();
+});
+
+test('the cell context carries what a custom cell needs', () => {
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridCellContext<Order, number>>().toEqualTypeOf<{
+    row: Order;
+    rowKey: DataGridKey;
+    value: number;
+    text: string;
+    column: {
+      readonly id: string;
+      readonly caption: string;
+      readonly dataType: DataGridDataType;
+      readonly align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end';
+    };
+    selected: boolean;
+  }>();
+});
+
+test('the sort item and the page hold JSON only', () => {
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridSortItem>().toEqualTypeOf<{
+    field: string;
+    direction: DataGridSortDirection;
+  }>();
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridPage>().toEqualTypeOf<{ index: number; size: number }>();
+  expectTypeOf<IsJson<DataGridSortItem>>().toEqualTypeOf<true>();
+  expectTypeOf<IsJson<readonly DataGridSortItem[]>>().toEqualTypeOf<true>();
+  expectTypeOf<IsJson<DataGridPage>>().toEqualTypeOf<true>();
+  // The check itself can fail: a Date is not JSON.
+  expectTypeOf<IsJson<{ at: Date }>>().toEqualTypeOf<false>();
+  expectTypeOf<IsJson<{ run(): void }>>().toEqualTypeOf<false>();
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/columns.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/columns.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..45c223b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/columns.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,513 @@
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import type { MockInstance } from 'vitest';
+import { WARN_PREFIX, resetDevWarnings } from '../../../internal/warn';
+import { dataGridColumn } from '../data-grid-column';
+import type { DataGridColumn } from '../types';
+import { checkFields, resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from './columns';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  status: number | null;
+  total: number | null;
+  placed: string | null;
+  at: number | null;
+  paid: boolean;
+  qty: number;
+}
+
+const ROW: Order = {
+  id: 'DH-1',
+  customer: 'An',
+  status: 2,
+  total: 1250000,
+  placed: '2026-11-05',
+  at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 20, 30),
+  paid: true,
+  qty: 3,
+};
+
+const OPTIONS = { locale: 'en-US', timeZone: 'UTC', yes: 'Yes', no: 'No', allowSorting: true };
+
+const STATUSES = [
+  { code: 1, name: 'New' },
+  { code: 2, name: 'Delivered' },
+];
+
+function resolve(columns: readonly DataGridColumn<Order>[], options = {}) {
+  return resolveColumns(columns, { ...OPTIONS, ...options });
+}
+
+function only(columns: readonly DataGridColumn<Order>[], options = {}): ResolvedColumn<Order> {
+  const resolved = resolve(columns, options);
+  expect(resolved).toHaveLength(1);
+  return resolved[0]!;
+}
+
+function warnings(spy: MockInstance): string[] {
+  return spy.mock.calls.map(([message]) => String(message));
+}
+
+describe('resolveColumns', () => {
+  let warn: MockInstance;
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    resetDevWarnings();
+    warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+  });
+  afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());
+
+  describe('what a column becomes', () => {
+    it('takes the id from the field, and the caption from the id', () => {
+      const column = only([{ field: 'customer' }]);
+      expect(column.id).toBe('customer');
+      expect(column.caption).toBe('customer');
+      expect(column.dataType).toBe('string');
+      expect(column.minWidth).toBe(60);
+      expect(column.width).toBeUndefined();
+      expect(column.rowHeader).toBe(false);
+      expect(column.info).toEqual({
+        id: 'customer',
+        caption: 'customer',
+        dataType: 'string',
+        align: 'start',
+      });
+      expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    });
+
+    it('lets a field column carry an id of its own, so one field can be shown twice', () => {
+      const resolved = resolve([
+        { field: 'total', caption: 'Total' },
+        { field: 'total', id: 'total-copy', caption: 'Copy' },
+      ]);
+      expect(resolved.map((column) => column.id)).toEqual(['total', 'total-copy']);
+      expect(resolved[1]!.value(ROW)).toBe(1250000);
+    });
+
+    it('reads a computed column by its value function', () => {
+      const column = only([{ id: 'amount', value: (row) => row.qty * 2, dataType: 'number' }]);
+      expect(column.id).toBe('amount');
+      expect(column.value(ROW)).toBe(6);
+      expect(column.text(ROW)).toBe('6');
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the caller object, the cell function and the given sizes', () => {
+      const cell = () => null;
+      const given: DataGridColumn<Order> = {
+        field: 'customer',
+        caption: 'Customer',
+        width: 248,
+        minWidth: 120,
+        cell,
+      };
+      const column = only([given]);
+      expect(column.column).toBe(given);
+      expect(column.cell).toBe(cell);
+      expect(column.caption).toBe('Customer');
+      expect(column.width).toBe(248);
+      expect(column.minWidth).toBe(120);
+    });
+
+    it('aligns by type: numbers to the end, booleans to the centre, the rest to the start', () => {
+      const align = (column: DataGridColumn<Order>) => only([column]).align;
+      expect(align({ field: 'total', dataType: 'number' })).toBe('end');
+      expect(align({ field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' })).toBe('center');
+      expect(align({ field: 'customer' })).toBe('start');
+      expect(align({ field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' })).toBe('start');
+      expect(align({ field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' })).toBe('start');
+      // A lookup shows words, even over a number.
+      expect(
+        align({
+          field: 'status',
+          dataType: 'number',
+          lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+        }),
+      ).toBe('start');
+      // The column's own align wins.
+      expect(align({ field: 'total', dataType: 'number', align: 'center' })).toBe('center');
+    });
+
+    it('takes a data type outside the union as a string, without a cast', () => {
+      const column = only([
+        { field: 'total', dataType: 'money' } as unknown as DataGridColumn<Order>,
+      ]);
+      expect(column.dataType).toBe('string');
+      expect(column.info.dataType).toBe('string');
+    });
+
+    it('lets the column decide whether it sorts, and the grid decide when it does not', () => {
+      const given = resolve([{ field: 'customer' }, { field: 'qty', allowSorting: false }]);
+      expect(given.map((column) => column.allowSorting)).toEqual([true, false]);
+      const off = resolve([{ field: 'customer' }, { field: 'qty', allowSorting: true }], {
+        allowSorting: false,
+      });
+      expect(off.map((column) => column.allowSorting)).toEqual([false, true]);
+    });
+
+    it('treats the first row header as the one, and warns about the others', () => {
+      const resolved = resolve([
+        { field: 'id', rowHeader: true },
+        { field: 'customer', rowHeader: true },
+      ]);
+      expect(resolved.map((column) => column.rowHeader)).toEqual([true, false]);
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> more than one column is a row header; only the first is.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('columns it leaves out', () => {
+    it('drops a column with neither a field nor an id with a value, with one warning', () => {
+      const resolved = resolve([
+        { field: 'customer' },
+        { id: 'broken' } as unknown as DataGridColumn<Order>,
+        { value: () => 1 } as unknown as DataGridColumn<Order>,
+        null as unknown as DataGridColumn<Order>,
+      ]);
+      expect(resolved.map((column) => column.id)).toEqual(['customer']);
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a column has neither a field nor an id with a value function; it is left out.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    it('drops the second of two columns with the same id', () => {
+      const first: DataGridColumn<Order> = { field: 'customer', caption: 'First' };
+      const resolved = resolve([first, { field: 'customer', caption: 'Second' }]);
+      expect(resolved).toHaveLength(1);
+      expect(resolved[0]!.column).toBe(first);
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> two columns have the same id; the second is left out.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    it('drops a column whose id starts with flg:, which is the grid’s own', () => {
+      const resolved = resolve([
+        { id: 'flg:select', value: () => 1 },
+        { field: 'customer', id: 'flg:mine' },
+        { field: 'qty' },
+      ]);
+      expect(resolved.map((column) => column.id)).toEqual(['qty']);
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a column id starts with "flg:", which is for the grid's own columns; the column is left out.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    it('does not touch what it is given', () => {
+      const columns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [{ field: 'customer' }, { field: 'customer' }];
+      const copy = [...columns];
+      resolve(columns);
+      expect(columns).toEqual(copy);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('widths', () => {
+    it('makes a column flexible, with a warning, when its width is not a number above 0', () => {
+      for (const width of [0, -10, Number.NaN, Infinity, '120' as unknown as number]) {
+        expect(only([{ field: 'customer', width }]).width).toBeUndefined();
+      }
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a column width is not a finite number above 0; the column is flexible.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    it('uses 60 for a minWidth that is not a number above 0, with a warning', () => {
+      expect(only([{ field: 'customer', minWidth: -5 }]).minWidth).toBe(60);
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a column minWidth is not a finite number above 0; 60 is used.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('text', () => {
+    it('writes each type as its default format does, in the locale', () => {
+      const column = (field: keyof Order, dataType: DataGridColumn<Order>['dataType']) =>
+        only([{ field, dataType } as DataGridColumn<Order>]);
+      expect(column('customer', 'string').text(ROW)).toBe('An');
+      expect(column('total', 'number').text(ROW)).toBe(
+        new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(1250000),
+      );
+      expect(column('placed', 'date').text(ROW)).toBe('11/05/2026');
+      expect(column('at', 'datetime').text(ROW)).toBe(
+        new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
+          dateStyle: 'short',
+          timeStyle: 'short',
+          timeZone: 'UTC',
+        }).format(ROW.at!),
+      );
+      expect(column('paid', 'boolean').text(ROW)).toBe('Yes');
+      expect(column('paid', 'boolean').text({ ...ROW, paid: false })).toBe('No');
+    });
+
+    it('writes in vi-VN, and a datetime in the zone it is given', () => {
+      const vi = { locale: 'vi-VN', timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' };
+      expect(only([{ field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' }], vi).text(ROW)).toBe('05/11/2026');
+      expect(only([{ field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' }], vi).text(ROW)).toBe(
+        new Intl.DateTimeFormat('vi-VN', {
+          dateStyle: 'short',
+          timeStyle: 'short',
+          timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
+        }).format(ROW.at!),
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('applies the Intl options of the column', () => {
+      const options = { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' } as const;
+      const column = only([{ field: 'total', dataType: 'number', format: options }], {
+        locale: 'vi-VN',
+      });
+      expect(column.text(ROW)).toBe(new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', options).format(1250000));
+    });
+
+    it('is empty for a blank value and never calls a format function on one', () => {
+      const format = vi.fn((value: number | null) => `#${value}`);
+      const column = only([{ field: 'total', dataType: 'number', format }]);
+      expect(column.text({ ...ROW, total: null })).toBe('');
+      expect(format).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+      expect(column.text(ROW)).toBe('#1250000');
+    });
+
+    it('calls a format function with the raw value and the row', () => {
+      const format = vi.fn((value: number | null, row: Order) => `${row.id}=${value}`);
+      expect(only([{ field: 'total', dataType: 'number', format }]).text(ROW)).toBe('DH-1=1250000');
+      expect(format).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1250000, ROW);
+    });
+
+    it('writes the text of a value the type refuses as blank', () => {
+      const column = only([{ field: 'total', dataType: 'number' }]);
+      expect(column.text({ ...ROW, total: 'abc' as unknown as number })).toBe('');
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('Intl options the constructor rejects', () => {
+    it('falls back to the default format with one warning, however many cells it writes', () => {
+      const column = only([{ field: 'total', dataType: 'number', format: { style: 'currency' } }]);
+      const text = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(1250000);
+      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) expect(column.text(ROW)).toBe(text);
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a column format is not valid Intl options; the default format is used.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    it('does the same for a date and a datetime column', () => {
+      const date = only([
+        { field: 'placed', dataType: 'date', format: { dateStyle: 'nope' } },
+      ] as never);
+      const datetime = only([
+        { field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime', format: { dateStyle: 'short', hour: 'numeric' } },
+      ]);
+      expect(date.text(ROW)).toBe('11/05/2026');
+      expect(datetime.text(ROW)).not.toBe('');
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toHaveLength(1);
+    });
+
+    it('uses UTC, with a warning, for a time zone Intl does not know', () => {
+      const column = only([{ field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' }], { timeZone: 'Mars/Olympus' });
+      expect(column.text(ROW)).toBe(only([{ field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' }]).text(ROW));
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> timeZone is not a time zone Intl knows; "UTC" is used.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('lookup', () => {
+    const lookup = { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' };
+
+    it('shows the display field of the item whose value field equals the value', () => {
+      const column = only([{ field: 'status', dataType: 'number', lookup }]);
+      expect(column.text(ROW)).toBe('Delivered');
+      expect(column.text({ ...ROW, status: 1 })).toBe('New');
+    });
+
+    it('shows nothing, and says nothing, for a value that no item has', () => {
+      const column = only([{ field: 'status', dataType: 'number', lookup }]);
+      expect(column.text({ ...ROW, status: 99 })).toBe('');
+      expect(column.text({ ...ROW, status: null })).toBe('');
+      expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    });
+
+    it('lets a format function win over the lookup, and ignores Intl options', () => {
+      const withFormat = only([
+        { field: 'status', dataType: 'number', lookup, format: (value) => `code ${value}` },
+      ]);
+      expect(withFormat.text(ROW)).toBe('code 2');
+      const withOptions = only([
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          dataType: 'number',
+          lookup,
+          format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' },
+        },
+      ]);
+      expect(withOptions.text(ROW)).toBe('Delivered');
+      expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    });
+
+    it('warns when the first item lacks the value field or the display field', () => {
+      only([
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          lookup: { items: [{ code: 1 }], valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+        },
+      ]);
+      only([
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          lookup: { items: [{ name: 'x' }], valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+        },
+      ]);
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> the first item of a lookup lacks its valueField or its displayField.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    it('says nothing for an empty list of items, which an app may fill later', () => {
+      expect(
+        only([
+          { field: 'status', lookup: { items: [], valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' } },
+        ]).text(ROW),
+      ).toBe('');
+      expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    });
+
+    it('reads a display field that is a number as its text', () => {
+      const column = only([
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          lookup: { items: [{ code: 2, name: 7 }], valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+        },
+      ]);
+      expect(column.text(ROW)).toBe('7');
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('sortKey', () => {
+    it('is the comparable of the value for each type', () => {
+      expect(only([{ field: 'customer' }]).sortKey(ROW)).toBe('An');
+      expect(only([{ field: 'total', dataType: 'number' }]).sortKey(ROW)).toBe(1250000);
+      expect(only([{ field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' }]).sortKey(ROW)).toBe(1);
+      expect(only([{ field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' }]).sortKey(ROW)).toBe(
+        Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5),
+      );
+      expect(only([{ field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' }]).sortKey(ROW)).toBe(ROW.at);
+      expect(
+        only([{ field: 'total', dataType: 'number' }]).sortKey({ ...ROW, total: null }),
+      ).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('is the lookup text for a lookup column, and null for a value no item has', () => {
+      const column = only([
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          dataType: 'number',
+          lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+        },
+      ]);
+      expect(column.sortKey(ROW)).toBe('Delivered');
+      expect(column.sortKey({ ...ROW, status: 99 })).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('is the sortValue of the column when there is one, read as a comparable', () => {
+      const sortValue = (row: Order) => row.customer.length;
+      expect(only([{ field: 'customer', sortValue }]).sortKey(ROW)).toBe(2);
+      const byType = (value: unknown) =>
+        only([{ field: 'customer', sortValue: () => value as string }]).sortKey(ROW);
+      expect(byType(true)).toBe(1);
+      expect(byType(false)).toBe(0);
+      expect(byType(new Date(5))).toBe(5);
+      expect(byType('x')).toBe('x');
+      for (const blank of [null, undefined, '', Number.NaN, new Date('nope'), {}]) {
+        expect(byType(blank)).toBeNull();
+      }
+    });
+
+    it('prefers the sortValue to the lookup', () => {
+      const column = only([
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+          sortValue: (row) => row.qty,
+        },
+      ]);
+      expect(column.sortKey(ROW)).toBe(3);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('the value', () => {
+    it('reads the property of a field column, and nothing from a row that is not an object', () => {
+      const column = only([{ field: 'qty' }]);
+      expect(column.value(ROW)).toBe(3);
+      expect(column.value(null as unknown as Order)).toBeUndefined();
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the type of a computed column made with dataGridColumn', () => {
+      const amount = dataGridColumn<Order>()({ id: 'amount', value: (row) => row.qty * 2 });
+      expect(only([amount]).value(ROW)).toBe(6);
+    });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('checkFields', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => resetDevWarnings());
+  afterEach(() => {
+    vi.restoreAllMocks();
+    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
+  });
+
+  const columns = (...definitions: DataGridColumn<Order>[]) => resolveColumns(definitions, OPTIONS);
+  const rows = (count: number, build: (index: number) => object = () => ROW): Order[] =>
+    Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => build(index) as Order);
+
+  it('warns when no row has the property of a field column', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    checkFields(columns({ field: 'custmer' as 'customer' }), rows(5));
+    expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+      `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> no row has the property a column names as its field; check its spelling.`,
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('is quiet when a row has it, even with the value undefined or null', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    checkFields(
+      columns({ field: 'total' }),
+      rows(3, () => ({ total: null })),
+    );
+    checkFields(
+      columns({ field: 'total' }),
+      rows(3, () => ({ total: undefined })),
+    );
+    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('looks at the first 20 rows only', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    const late = rows(25, (index) => (index === 20 ? ROW : { id: 'x' }));
+    checkFields(columns({ field: 'customer' }), late);
+    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    resetDevWarnings();
+    const edge = rows(25, (index) => (index === 19 ? ROW : { id: 'x' }));
+    checkFields(columns({ field: 'customer' }), edge);
+    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+
+  it('says nothing about no rows, and nothing about a value column', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    checkFields(columns({ field: 'customer' }), []);
+    checkFields(columns({ id: 'amount', value: () => 1 }), rows(3));
+    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('is not computed in production: the rows are not even read', () => {
+    vi.stubEnv('NODE_ENV', 'production');
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    let reads = 0;
+    const watched = new Proxy(rows(5), {
+      get(target, property, receiver) {
+        reads += 1;
+        return Reflect.get(target, property, receiver);
+      },
+    });
+    checkFields(columns({ field: 'custmer' as 'customer' }), watched);
+    expect(reads).toBe(0);
+    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/flatten.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/flatten.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a12fa53
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/flatten.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { flattenRows } from './flatten';
+
+describe('flattenRows', () => {
+  const rows = [{ id: 'DH-1' }, { id: 'DH-2' }, { id: 'DH-3' }];
+
+  it('makes one data row for each row, in order, with its place in the list', () => {
+    const flat = flattenRows(rows, (row) => row.id);
+    expect(flat).toEqual([
+      { kind: 'data', key: 'DH-1', row: rows[0], index: 0 },
+      { kind: 'data', key: 'DH-2', row: rows[1], index: 1 },
+      { kind: 'data', key: 'DH-3', row: rows[2], index: 2 },
+    ]);
+    expect(flat[1]!.row).toBe(rows[1]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives getKey the row and its index, once each', () => {
+    const getKey = vi.fn((_row: { id: string }, index: number) => index * 10);
+    expect(flattenRows(rows, getKey).map((entry) => entry.key)).toEqual([0, 10, 20]);
+    expect(getKey).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+    expect(getKey).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, rows[1], 1);
+  });
+
+  it('gives an empty list for no rows, and does not change its input', () => {
+    expect(flattenRows([], () => 0)).toEqual([]);
+    const copy = [...rows];
+    flattenRows(rows, (row) => row.id);
+    expect(rows).toEqual(copy);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/layout.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/layout.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b9b1e44
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/layout.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { resolveWidths } from './layout';
+
+const flexible = (minWidth = 60) => ({ width: undefined, minWidth });
+const fixed = (width: number, minWidth = 60) => ({ width, minWidth });
+const sum = (widths: readonly number[]) => widths.reduce((total, width) => total + width, 0);
+
+describe('resolveWidths', () => {
+  it('gives a fixed width as it is', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([fixed(100), fixed(250.5)], 1000)).toEqual([100, 250.5]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps a fixed width that is under the minimum of its column', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([fixed(40, 120)], 1000)).toEqual([40]);
+  });
+
+  it('shares what is left among the flexible columns equally', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(), flexible()], 1000)).toEqual([500, 500]);
+    expect(resolveWidths([fixed(100), flexible(), flexible()], 1000)).toEqual([100, 450, 450]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives whole pixels, the remainder going to the last flexible columns', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(), flexible()], 1001)).toEqual([500, 501]);
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(10), flexible(10), flexible(10)], 100)).toEqual([33, 33, 34]);
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(10), flexible(10), flexible(10)], 101)).toEqual([33, 34, 34]);
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(10), fixed(50), flexible(10), flexible(10)], 100)).toEqual([
+      16, 50, 17, 17,
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('holds a column at its minimum and leaves the rest to the others', () => {
+    // An equal share of 300 is 150 each, which is under the 200 of the second.
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(60), flexible(200)], 300)).toEqual([100, 200]);
+    // Two columns held at 200 leave 100 for the first.
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(60), flexible(200), flexible(200)], 500)).toEqual([
+      100, 200, 200,
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('is the sum of the minimums when nothing is left to share', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(60), flexible(200)], 100)).toEqual([60, 200]);
+    expect(resolveWidths([fixed(100), flexible(60), flexible(80)], 150)).toEqual([100, 60, 80]);
+  });
+
+  it('adds up to the available width, or to fixed plus minimums when that is more', () => {
+    const minimums = [100, 60, 200, 75];
+    const columns = [fixed(100), flexible(60), flexible(200), flexible(75)];
+    for (const available of [0, 99, 100, 257, 640, 1280, 1919]) {
+      const widths = resolveWidths(columns, available);
+      expect(sum(widths)).toBe(Math.max(available, sum(minimums)));
+      widths.forEach((width, index) => expect(width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(minimums[index]!));
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('leaves the table narrower than the frame when no column is flexible', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([fixed(100), fixed(200)], 1000)).toEqual([100, 200]);
+  });
+
+  it('reads a fractional minimum as the next whole pixel, so the sum stays whole', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(60.2), flexible(60.2)], 100)).toEqual([61, 61]);
+  });
+
+  it('takes an available width that is not a number, or is negative, as 0', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(60)], Number.NaN)).toEqual([60]);
+    expect(resolveWidths([flexible(60)], -10)).toEqual([60]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives nothing for no columns', () => {
+    expect(resolveWidths([], 500)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/page.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/page.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fdebd4d

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { FlatRow } from './flatten';
+import { clampPageIndex, pageCount, pageRows } from './page';
+
+function flat(count: number): FlatRow<{ n: number }>[] {
+  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
+    kind: 'data' as const,
+    key: index,
+    row: { n: index },
+    index,
+  }));
+}
+
+describe('pageCount', () => {
+  it('rounds up', () => {
+    expect(pageCount(135, 12)).toBe(12);
+    expect(pageCount(120, 12)).toBe(10);
+    expect(pageCount(121, 12)).toBe(11);
+    expect(pageCount(1, 20)).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('is at least 1, even with no rows', () => {
+    expect(pageCount(0, 20)).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('is 1 for a size that is not a number above 0', () => {
+    for (const size of [0, -5, Number.NaN, Infinity]) expect(pageCount(50, size)).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('reads a fractional size as its whole part', () => {
+    expect(pageCount(10, 2.9)).toBe(5);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('clampPageIndex', () => {
+  it('keeps an index that is in range', () => {
+    expect(clampPageIndex(0, 135, 12)).toBe(0);
+    expect(clampPageIndex(5, 135, 12)).toBe(5);
+    expect(clampPageIndex(11, 135, 12)).toBe(11);
+  });
+
+  it('brings an index past the end back to the last page, and one below 0 to 0', () => {
+    expect(clampPageIndex(12, 135, 12)).toBe(11);
+    expect(clampPageIndex(1000, 135, 12)).toBe(11);
+    expect(clampPageIndex(-3, 135, 12)).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('gives a whole number: a fraction is cut, anything not finite is 0', () => {
+    expect(clampPageIndex(2.8, 135, 12)).toBe(2);
+    for (const index of [Number.NaN, Infinity, -Infinity]) {
+      expect(clampPageIndex(index, 135, 12)).toBe(0);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('is 0 when there are no rows', () => {
+    expect(clampPageIndex(4, 0, 12)).toBe(0);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('pageRows', () => {
+  it('cuts the rows of a page, with their place in the whole list', () => {
+    const page = pageRows(flat(30), { index: 1, size: 12 });
+    expect(page).toHaveLength(12);
+    expect(page[0]!.index).toBe(12);
+    expect(page.at(-1)!.index).toBe(23);
+  });
+
+  it('gives a short last page', () => {
+    expect(pageRows(flat(30), { index: 2, size: 12 })).toHaveLength(6);
+  });
+
+  it('cuts the clamped page, so a page past the end shows the last one', () => {
+    expect(pageRows(flat(30), { index: 9, size: 12 })[0]!.index).toBe(24);
+    expect(pageRows(flat(30), { index: -1, size: 12 })[0]!.index).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('gives nothing for no rows', () => {
+    expect(pageRows([], { index: 3, size: 10 })).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives every row for a size that is not a number above 0', () => {
+    expect(pageRows(flat(5), { index: 0, size: 0 })).toHaveLength(5);
+    expect(pageRows(flat(5), { index: 2, size: Number.NaN })).toHaveLength(5);
+  });
+
+  it('does not change what it is given', () => {
+    const rows = flat(30);
+    pageRows(rows, { index: 1, size: 12 });
+    expect(rows).toHaveLength(30);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/perf.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/perf.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..05dec30
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/perf.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridSortItem } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import { flattenRows } from './flatten';
+import { pageRows } from './page';
+import { sortRows } from './sort';
+import { computeOffsets, findWindow } from './virtual';
+
+// The targets of spec 3.5 for 10 000 rows by 9 columns on a mid-range laptop. CI is slower and
+// noisier, so the test asks for under three times each; the real figures are measured on the
+// owner's machine and go in the PR description.
+const SORT_TARGET_MS = 50;
+const WINDOW_TARGET_MS = 5;
+const SLACK = 3;
+const RUNS = 5;
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  assignee: number;
+  placed: string;
+  at: number;
+  status: number;
+  channel: string;
+  qty: number;
+  total: number;
+  paid: boolean;
+}
+
+// Mulberry32: a small generator with a seed, so every run sorts the same rows. `Math.random` would
+// make a slow run impossible to repeat.
+function seeded(seed: number): () => number {
+  let state = seed;
+  return () => {
+    state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
+    let t = Math.imul(state ^ (state >>> 15), 1 | state);
+    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
+    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
+  };
+}
+
+const NAMES = ['Nguyễn Văn An', 'Trần Thị Bình', 'Lê Minh Châu', 'Phạm Quốc Dũng', 'Đỗ Thu Hà'];
+const CHANNELS = ['Store', 'Website', 'Phone'];
+const STATUSES = [
+  { code: 0, name: 'New' },
+  { code: 1, name: 'Processing' },
+  { code: 2, name: 'Delivered' },
+  { code: 3, name: 'Cancelled' },
+];
+const PEOPLE = NAMES.map((name, index) => ({ code: index, name }));
+
+function makeOrders(count: number): Order[] {
+  const random = seeded(2026);
+  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
+    id: `DH-${1000 + index}`,
+    customer: NAMES[Math.floor(random() * NAMES.length)]!,
+    assignee: Math.floor(random() * PEOPLE.length),
+    placed: `2026-${String(1 + Math.floor(random() * 12)).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(1 + Math.floor(random() * 28)).padStart(2, '0')}`,
+    at: Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1) + Math.floor(random() * 300 * 86_400_000),
+    status: Math.floor(random() * STATUSES.length),
+    channel: CHANNELS[Math.floor(random() * CHANNELS.length)]!,
+    qty: 1 + Math.floor(random() * 20),
+    total: Math.floor(random() * 50_000_000),
+    paid: random() > 0.5,
+  }));
+}
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id' },
+  { field: 'customer' },
+  {
+    field: 'assignee',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    lookup: { items: PEOPLE, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+  },
+  { field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' },
+  { field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+  },
+  { field: 'qty', dataType: 'number' },
+  { field: 'total', dataType: 'number' },
+  { field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' },
+];
+
+const resolved = resolveColumns(COLUMNS, {
+  locale: 'vi-VN',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+});
+
+function median(run: () => void): number {
+  const times: number[] = [];
+  for (let i = 0; i < RUNS; i++) {
+    const start = performance.now();
+    run();
+    times.push(performance.now() - start);
+  }
+  times.sort((a, b) => a - b);
+  return times[Math.floor(RUNS / 2)]!;
+}
+
+describe('performance of the engine on 10 000 rows by 9 columns', () => {
+  const orders = makeOrders(10_000);
+
+  it('makes the same rows every time (the generator has a seed)', () => {
+    expect(makeOrders(3)).toEqual(makeOrders(3));
+    expect(orders).toHaveLength(10_000);
+    expect(resolved).toHaveLength(9);
+  });
+
+  it(`sorts on two levels in under ${SORT_TARGET_MS * SLACK} ms`, () => {
+    // A lookup by its text, then a number, so the keys are the costly kind.
+    const items: DataGridSortItem[] = [
+      { field: 'status', direction: 'asc' },
+      { field: 'total', direction: 'desc' },
+    ];
+    const sorted = sortRows(orders, items, resolved, 'vi-VN');
+    expect(sorted).toHaveLength(10_000);
+    // Cancelled, Delivered, New, Processing by text; the biggest total first inside each.
+    expect(sorted[0]!.status).toBe(3);
+    expect(sorted.at(-1)!.status).toBe(1);
+    expect(sorted[1]!.total).toBeLessThanOrEqual(sorted[0]!.total);
+    const ms = median(() => sortRows(orders, items, resolved, 'vi-VN'));
+    console.log(
+      `sort, two levels, 10 000 rows: median of ${RUNS} runs ${ms.toFixed(1)} ms (target ${SORT_TARGET_MS} ms)`,
+    );
+    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(SORT_TARGET_MS * SLACK);
+  });
+
+  it(`flattens, pages and finds a window in under ${WINDOW_TARGET_MS * SLACK} ms`, () => {
+    const run = () => {
+      const flat = flattenRows(orders, (row) => row.id);
+      pageRows(flat, { index: 3, size: 100 });
+      const offsets = computeOffsets(flat.length, () => 41);
+      return findWindow(offsets, 200_000, 800, 6);
+    };
+    expect(run()).toEqual({ start: 4_872, end: 4_904 });
+    const ms = median(run);
+    console.log(
+      `flatten + page + offsets + window, 10 000 rows: median of ${RUNS} runs ${ms.toFixed(1)} ms (target ${WINDOW_TARGET_MS} ms)`,
+    );
+    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(WINDOW_TARGET_MS * SLACK);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/pipeline.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/pipeline.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a664a8a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/pipeline.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,227 @@
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridSortItem } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import { createPipeline } from './pipeline';
+import type { PipelineInput } from './pipeline';
+import { sortRows } from './sort';
+
+// The real `sortRows`, counted, to show which runs of the pipeline sort again.
+vi.mock('./sort', async (importOriginal) => {
+  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('./sort')>();
+  return { ...actual, sortRows: vi.fn(actual.sortRows) };
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  qty: number;
+}
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [{ field: 'id' }, { field: 'qty', dataType: 'number' }];
+const resolved = resolveColumns(COLUMNS, {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+});
+
+const DATA: readonly Order[] = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, index) => ({
+  id: `DH-${index + 1}`,
+  qty: (index * 7) % 11,
+}));
+
+const getKey = (row: Order) => row.id;
+
+function input(patch: Partial<PipelineInput<Order>> = {}): PipelineInput<Order> {
+  return {
+    data: DATA,
+    columns: resolved,
+    getKey,
+    sort: [],
+    page: null,
+    remote: false,
+    totalCount: undefined,
+    locale: 'en-US',
+    ...patch,
+  };
+}
+
+const qtyAsc: DataGridSortItem[] = [{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }];
+const sorts = vi.mocked(sortRows);
+
+describe('createPipeline', () => {
+  // Braces: a function returned from a hook is run as its cleanup, and mockClear returns the mock.
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    sorts.mockClear();
+  });
+
+  describe('what it gives', () => {
+    it('gives every row as one page, in the order of the data, when there is no sort and no paging', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(input());
+      expect(result.rows).toBe(DATA);
+      expect(result.flat).toHaveLength(30);
+      expect(result.visible).toBe(result.flat);
+      expect(result.total).toBe(30);
+      expect(result.pageCount).toBe(1);
+      expect(result.pageIndex).toBe(0);
+      expect(result.flat[4]).toEqual({ kind: 'data', key: 'DH-5', row: DATA[4], index: 4 });
+    });
+
+    it('sorts, then cuts the page, and numbers the rows by their place in the whole list', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ sort: qtyAsc, page: { index: 1, size: 12 } }),
+      );
+      expect(result.rows.map((row) => row.qty)).toEqual(
+        [...DATA].map((row) => row.qty).sort((a, b) => a - b),
+      );
+      expect(result.flat).toHaveLength(30);
+      expect(result.visible).toHaveLength(12);
+      expect(result.visible[0]!.index).toBe(12);
+      expect(result.visible[0]!.row).toBe(result.rows[12]);
+      expect(result.total).toBe(30);
+      expect(result.pageCount).toBe(3);
+      expect(result.pageIndex).toBe(1);
+    });
+
+    it('shows a page past the end as the last page, and says which page that is', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ page: { index: 99, size: 12 } }));
+      expect(result.pageIndex).toBe(2);
+      expect(result.visible).toHaveLength(6);
+    });
+
+    it('does not change the data, nor the sort items', () => {
+      const data = [...DATA];
+      const sort = [...qtyAsc];
+      createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ data, sort }));
+      expect(data).toEqual(DATA);
+      expect(sort).toEqual(qtyAsc);
+    });
+
+    it('gives nothing for no data, with one page', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ data: [], page: { index: 0, size: 10 } }));
+      expect(result.flat).toEqual([]);
+      expect(result.visible).toEqual([]);
+      expect(result.total).toBe(0);
+      expect(result.pageCount).toBe(1);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('server mode', () => {
+    it('neither sorts nor pages: the data is the page', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ remote: true, sort: qtyAsc, page: { index: 3, size: 12 }, totalCount: 135 }),
+      );
+      expect(sorts).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+      expect(result.rows).toBe(DATA);
+      expect(result.visible).toBe(result.flat);
+      expect(result.visible).toHaveLength(30);
+    });
+
+    it('counts totalCount, and the pages from it', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ remote: true, page: { index: 3, size: 12 }, totalCount: 135 }),
+      );
+      expect(result.total).toBe(135);
+      expect(result.pageCount).toBe(12);
+      expect(result.pageIndex).toBe(3);
+    });
+
+    it('counts the data when totalCount is missing, and clamps the page to what it counts', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ remote: true, page: { index: 9, size: 12 }, totalCount: undefined }),
+      );
+      expect(result.total).toBe(30);
+      expect(result.pageCount).toBe(3);
+      expect(result.pageIndex).toBe(2);
+    });
+
+    it('leaves the page index at 0 without paging', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ remote: true, totalCount: 135 }));
+      expect(result.pageCount).toBe(1);
+      expect(result.pageIndex).toBe(0);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('what it remembers', () => {
+    it('gives the same objects for the same inputs', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, page: { index: 0, size: 12 } }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, page: { index: 0, size: 12 } }));
+      expect(second).toBe(first);
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('reads a sort by its value: a new array with the same items is the same sort', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ sort: [{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }] }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ sort: [{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }] }));
+      expect(second.rows).toBe(first.rows);
+      expect(second.flat).toBe(first.flat);
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('does not sort again for a new page: only the page step runs', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, page: { index: 0, size: 12 } }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, page: { index: 1, size: 12 } }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(second.rows).toBe(first.rows);
+      expect(second.flat).toBe(first.flat);
+      expect(second.visible).not.toBe(first.visible);
+      expect(second.visible[0]!.index).toBe(12);
+      // A new page size is a new page too.
+      const third = pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, page: { index: 1, size: 6 } }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(third.visible).toHaveLength(6);
+    });
+
+    it('sorts again for a new sort', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc }));
+      const desc = pipeline.run(input({ sort: [{ field: 'qty', direction: 'desc' }] }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(desc.rows[0]!.qty).toBe(10);
+    });
+
+    it('sorts again, and numbers the rows again, for new data', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, data: DATA.slice(0, 10) }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(second.flat).not.toBe(first.flat);
+      expect(second.total).toBe(10);
+    });
+
+    it('sorts again for new columns or a new locale, which change what a key is', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc }));
+      pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, locale: 'vi-VN' }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      pipeline.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc, locale: 'vi-VN', columns: [...resolved] }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+    });
+
+    it('does not sort at all when no sort item is in effect, and keeps the data as the rows', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const result = pipeline.run(input({ sort: [{ field: 'gone', direction: 'asc' }] }));
+      expect(result.rows).toBe(DATA);
+    });
+
+    it('numbers the rows again for a new getKey, since a key may depend on it', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input());
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ getKey: (row) => `#${row.id}` }));
+      expect(second.flat).not.toBe(first.flat);
+      expect(second.flat[0]!.key).toBe('#DH-1');
+      expect(second.rows).toBe(first.rows);
+    });
+
+    it('keeps each pipeline to itself', () => {
+      const a = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const b = createPipeline<Order>();
+      a.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc }));
+      b.run(input({ sort: qtyAsc }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    });
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/sort.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/sort.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..09e7f68
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/sort.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../../internal/warn';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridSortItem } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import { sortRows } from './sort';
+
+interface Row {
+  id: string;
+  name: string | null;
+  qty: number | null;
+  day: string | null;
+  paid: boolean | null;
+  status: number | null;
+}
+
+const STATUSES = [
+  { code: 1, name: 'Processing' },
+  { code: 2, name: 'Delivered' },
+  { code: 3, name: 'New' },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Row>[] = [
+  { field: 'id' },
+  { field: 'name' },
+  { field: 'qty', dataType: 'number' },
+  { field: 'day', dataType: 'date' },
+  { field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+  },
+  { field: 'qty', id: 'locked', dataType: 'number', allowSorting: false },
+  { id: 'len', value: (row) => row.name, sortValue: (row) => row.name?.length },
+];
+
+const resolved = resolveColumns(COLUMNS, {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+});
+
+function row(id: string, patch: Partial<Row> = {}): Row {
+  return { id, name: id, qty: 0, day: null, paid: null, status: null, ...patch };
+}
+
+const sort = (rows: readonly Row[], ...items: DataGridSortItem[]) =>
+  sortRows(rows, items, resolved, 'en-US');
+const ids = (rows: readonly Row[]) => rows.map((r) => r.id);
+const asc = (field: string): DataGridSortItem => ({ field, direction: 'asc' });
+const desc = (field: string): DataGridSortItem => ({ field, direction: 'desc' });
+
+describe('sortRows', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => resetDevWarnings());
+  afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());
+
+  it('sorts numbers up and down', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { qty: 5 }), row('b', { qty: -2 }), row('c', { qty: 30 })];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('qty')))).toEqual(['b', 'a', 'c']);
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, desc('qty')))).toEqual(['c', 'a', 'b']);
+  });
+
+  it('puts "DH-2" before "DH-10": strings compare by the numbers inside', () => {
+    const rows = [row('DH-10'), row('DH-2'), row('DH-1')];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('id')))).toEqual(['DH-1', 'DH-2', 'DH-10']);
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, desc('id')))).toEqual(['DH-10', 'DH-2', 'DH-1']);
+  });
+
+  it('compares strings with the collator of the locale', () => {
+    const rows = [row('z', { name: 'Zoe' }), row('a', { name: 'Ân' }), row('b', { name: 'Bình' })];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('name')))).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'z']);
+  });
+
+  it('sorts dates by day and booleans false before true', () => {
+    const days = [
+      row('a', { day: '2026-11-05' }),
+      row('b', { day: '2025-12-31' }),
+      row('c', { day: '2026-01-02' }),
+    ];
+    expect(ids(sort(days, asc('day')))).toEqual(['b', 'c', 'a']);
+    const flags = [row('a', { paid: true }), row('b', { paid: false }), row('c', { paid: true })];
+    expect(ids(sort(flags, asc('paid')))).toEqual(['b', 'a', 'c']);
+    expect(ids(sort(flags, desc('paid')))).toEqual(['a', 'c', 'b']);
+  });
+
+  it('sorts a lookup column by the text it shows, not by its value', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { status: 1 }), row('b', { status: 2 }), row('c', { status: 3 })];
+    // Processing, Delivered, New by code; Delivered, New, Processing by text.
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('status')))).toEqual(['b', 'c', 'a']);
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, desc('status')))).toEqual(['a', 'c', 'b']);
+  });
+
+  it('uses the sortValue of the column in place of the value', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { name: 'bbb' }), row('b', { name: 'c' }), row('c', { name: 'aa' })];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('len')))).toEqual(['b', 'c', 'a']);
+  });
+
+  it('puts blanks last in both directions', () => {
+    const rows = [
+      row('a', { qty: null }),
+      row('b', { qty: 2 }),
+      row('c', { qty: Number.NaN }),
+      row('d', { qty: 1 }),
+    ];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('qty')))).toEqual(['d', 'b', 'a', 'c']);
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, desc('qty')))).toEqual(['b', 'd', 'a', 'c']);
+    const names = [row('a', { name: null }), row('b', { name: 'x' }), row('c', { name: '' })];
+    expect(ids(sort(names, desc('name')))).toEqual(['b', 'a', 'c']);
+    const lookup = [row('a', { status: 99 }), row('b', { status: 2 })];
+    expect(ids(sort(lookup, asc('status')))).toEqual(['b', 'a']);
+    expect(ids(sort(lookup, desc('status')))).toEqual(['b', 'a']);
+  });
+
+  it('is stable: equal rows keep their order, in both directions', () => {
+    const rows = [
+      row('a', { qty: 1 }),
+      row('b', { qty: 1 }),
+      row('c', { qty: 0 }),
+      row('d', { qty: 1 }),
+    ];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('qty')))).toEqual(['c', 'a', 'b', 'd']);
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, desc('qty')))).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'd', 'c']);
+  });
+
+  it('sorts by a second item inside the equal runs of the first', () => {
+    const rows = [
+      row('a', { day: '2026-11-05', qty: 30 }),
+      row('b', { day: '2026-11-06', qty: 10 }),
+      row('c', { day: '2026-11-05', qty: 10 }),
+      row('d', { day: '2026-11-06', qty: 20 }),
+    ];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, desc('day'), asc('qty')))).toEqual(['b', 'd', 'c', 'a']);
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('day'), desc('qty')))).toEqual(['a', 'c', 'd', 'b']);
+  });
+
+  it('puts numbers before strings when a sortValue gives both, so the order is the same every time', () => {
+    const mixed = resolveColumns<Row>(
+      [{ id: 'm', value: () => 0, sortValue: (r) => (r.id === 'b' ? r.id : r.qty) }],
+      { locale: 'en-US', timeZone: 'UTC', yes: 'Yes', no: 'No', allowSorting: true },
+    );
+    const rows = [row('a', { qty: 3 }), row('b'), row('c', { qty: 1 })];
+    expect(ids(sortRows(rows, [asc('m')], mixed, 'en-US'))).toEqual(['c', 'a', 'b']);
+    expect(ids(sortRows(rows, [desc('m')], mixed, 'en-US'))).toEqual(['b', 'a', 'c']);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores, silently, items it cannot use', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    const rows = [row('a', { qty: 2 }), row('b', { qty: 1 })];
+    // An unknown column, a column that does not sort, and a direction that is neither.
+    expect(sort(rows, asc('gone'))).toBe(rows);
+    expect(sort(rows, asc('locked'))).toBe(rows);
+    expect(sort(rows, { field: 'qty', direction: 'up' as 'asc' })).toBe(rows);
+    expect(sort(rows, { field: 'gone', direction: 'asc' }, asc('qty')).map((r) => r.id)).toEqual([
+      'b',
+      'a',
+    ]);
+    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('uses the first item of a field that appears twice', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { qty: 2 }), row('b', { qty: 1 })];
+    expect(ids(sort(rows, asc('qty'), desc('qty')))).toEqual(['b', 'a']);
+  });
+
+  it('returns the very array it was given when no item is in effect', () => {
+    const rows = [row('b'), row('a')];
+    expect(sort(rows)).toBe(rows);
+    expect(sort(rows, asc('gone'))).toBe(rows);
+  });
+
+  it('does not change its input, and returns a new array otherwise', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { qty: 2 }), row('b', { qty: 1 })];
+    const before = [...rows];
+    const sorted = sort(rows, asc('qty'));
+    expect(rows).toEqual(before);
+    expect(sorted).not.toBe(rows);
+    expect(Object.isFrozen(rows)).toBe(false);
+    const frozen = Object.freeze([row('a', { qty: 2 }), row('b', { qty: 1 })]);
+    expect(() => sort(frozen, asc('qty'))).not.toThrow();
+  });
+
+  it('reads the key of each row once per item, however many comparisons it makes', () => {
+    const calls = vi.fn((r: Row) => r.qty);
+    const counted = resolveColumns<Row>([{ field: 'qty', dataType: 'number', sortValue: calls }], {
+      locale: 'en-US',
+      timeZone: 'UTC',
+      yes: 'Yes',
+      no: 'No',
+      allowSorting: true,
+    });
+    const rows = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, index) =>
+      row(String(index), { qty: (index * 7) % 13 }),
+    );
+    sortRows(rows, [asc('qty')], counted, 'en-US');
+    expect(calls).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(200);
+  });
+
+  it('sorts an empty list', () => {
+    expect(sort([], asc('qty'))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/values.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/values.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f07a19f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/values.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,292 @@
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import type { MockInstance } from 'vitest';
+import { WARN_PREFIX, resetDevWarnings } from '../../../internal/warn';
+import { createTextCache, formatValue, isBlank, toComparable } from './values';
+
+const DAY = 86_400_000;
+const NOV_5 = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5);
+const OPTIONS = { locale: 'en-US', timeZone: 'UTC', yes: 'Yes', no: 'No' };
+
+function warnings(spy: MockInstance): string[] {
+  return spy.mock.calls.map(([message]) => String(message));
+}
+
+describe('values', () => {
+  let warn: MockInstance;
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    resetDevWarnings();
+    warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+  });
+  afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());
+
+  describe('isBlank', () => {
+    it('is true for null, undefined, an empty string, NaN and an invalid date', () => {
+      for (const value of [null, undefined, '', Number.NaN, new Date('nope')]) {
+        expect(isBlank(value)).toBe(true);
+      }
+    });
+
+    it('is false for everything that is a value, 0, false and a space included', () => {
+      for (const value of [0, false, ' ', 'x', -1, Infinity, new Date(0), [], {}]) {
+        expect(isBlank(value)).toBe(false);
+      }
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('toComparable', () => {
+    it('gives null for a blank value of every type', () => {
+      for (const dataType of ['string', 'number', 'date', 'datetime', 'boolean'] as const) {
+        for (const value of [null, undefined, '', Number.NaN, new Date('nope')]) {
+          expect(toComparable(value, dataType)).toBeNull();
+        }
+      }
+      expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    });
+
+    it('takes a string as it is, and a number or bigint as its text', () => {
+      expect(toComparable('DH-1', 'string')).toBe('DH-1');
+      expect(toComparable(42, 'string')).toBe('42');
+      expect(toComparable(10n, 'string')).toBe('10');
+    });
+
+    it('takes a number as it is', () => {
+      expect(toComparable(-3.5, 'number')).toBe(-3.5);
+      expect(toComparable(0, 'number')).toBe(0);
+    });
+
+    it('turns a boolean into 0 or 1', () => {
+      expect(toComparable(false, 'boolean')).toBe(0);
+      expect(toComparable(true, 'boolean')).toBe(1);
+    });
+
+    it('reads a date as its UTC calendar day', () => {
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05', 'date')).toBe(NOV_5);
+      expect(toComparable(new Date(NOV_5), 'date')).toBe(NOV_5);
+      // The time of day does not move the day, and the zone of the machine does not either.
+      expect(toComparable(new Date(NOV_5 + DAY - 1), 'date')).toBe(NOV_5);
+      expect(toComparable(new Date(NOV_5 + 23 * 3_600_000), 'date')).toBe(NOV_5);
+      expect(
+        Number(toComparable('2026-11-06', 'date')) - Number(toComparable('2026-11-05', 'date')),
+      ).toBe(DAY);
+    });
+
+    it('reads a datetime as an instant: a Date, milliseconds or an ISO string with an offset', () => {
+      const instant = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 20, 30);
+      expect(toComparable(new Date(instant), 'datetime')).toBe(instant);
+      expect(toComparable(instant, 'datetime')).toBe(instant);
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05T20:30:00Z', 'datetime')).toBe(instant);
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05T20:30Z', 'datetime')).toBe(instant);
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05T20:30:00.250Z', 'datetime')).toBe(instant + 250);
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-06T03:30:00+07:00', 'datetime')).toBe(instant);
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05T15:00:00-05:30', 'datetime')).toBe(instant);
+    });
+
+    it('refuses a datetime string without an offset, so no machine zone is ever read', () => {
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05T20:30:00', 'datetime')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05', 'datetime')).toBeNull();
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a datetime column has a value that is not a Date, a number of milliseconds or an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset (Z or +hh:mm); it is shown blank.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    it('refuses a datetime string that is not a real moment', () => {
+      for (const text of [
+        '2026-13-05T20:30:00Z',
+        '2026-02-30T20:30:00Z',
+        '2026-11-05T24:00:00Z',
+        '2026-11-05T20:60:00Z',
+        '2026-11-05T20:30:60Z',
+        '2026-11-05T20:30:00+24:00',
+        'not a date',
+      ]) {
+        expect(toComparable(text, 'datetime')).toBeNull();
+      }
+    });
+
+    it('refuses what a date column cannot read, and never reads a string with new Date()', () => {
+      expect(toComparable('2026-02-30', 'date')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable('11/05/2026', 'date')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable('November 5, 2026', 'date')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable('2026-11-05T10:00:00Z', 'date')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable(NOV_5, 'date')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable(true, 'date')).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('refuses what a number or a boolean column cannot read', () => {
+      expect(toComparable('12', 'number')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable(Infinity, 'number')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable(true, 'number')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable(1, 'boolean')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable('true', 'boolean')).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('refuses an object in a string column', () => {
+      expect(toComparable({}, 'string')).toBeNull();
+      expect(toComparable(true, 'string')).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('warns once per type, in words that hold no value', () => {
+      toComparable('12', 'number');
+      toComparable('34', 'number');
+      toComparable('nope', 'date');
+      toComparable('nope again', 'date');
+      toComparable('yes', 'boolean');
+      toComparable({ secret: 'value' }, 'string');
+      expect(warnings(warn)).toEqual([
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a number column has a value that is not a finite number; it is shown blank.`,
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a date column has a value that is not a Date or a YYYY-MM-DD string; it is shown blank.`,
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a boolean column has a value that is not true or false; it is shown blank.`,
+        `${WARN_PREFIX} <DataGrid> a string column has a value that is not a string or a number; it is shown blank.`,
+      ]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('formatValue', () => {
+    it('gives an empty text for a blank value, and for one the type refuses', () => {
+      expect(formatValue(null, 'string', OPTIONS)).toBe('');
+      expect(formatValue('', 'number', OPTIONS)).toBe('');
+      expect(formatValue(Number.NaN, 'number', OPTIONS)).toBe('');
+      expect(formatValue('abc', 'number', OPTIONS)).toBe('');
+      expect(formatValue('2026-02-30', 'date', OPTIONS)).toBe('');
+      expect(formatValue('2026-11-05T10:00:00', 'datetime', OPTIONS)).toBe('');
+    });
+
+    it('writes a string as it is', () => {
+      expect(formatValue('Nguyễn Văn An', 'string', OPTIONS)).toBe('Nguyễn Văn An');
+    });
+
+    it('writes a number in the locale, as Intl does', () => {
+      expect(formatValue(1234567.891, 'number', OPTIONS)).toBe(
+        new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(1234567.891),
+      );
+      expect(formatValue(1234567.891, 'number', { ...OPTIONS, locale: 'vi-VN' })).toBe(
+        new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(1234567.891),
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('applies the Intl options of the column to a number', () => {
+      const options = { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' } as const;
+      expect(formatValue(1250000, 'number', { ...OPTIONS, locale: 'vi-VN', options })).toBe(
+        new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', options).format(1250000),
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('writes a date as day, month and year in the order of the locale', () => {
+      expect(formatValue('2026-11-05', 'date', OPTIONS)).toBe('11/05/2026');
+      expect(formatValue('2026-11-05', 'date', { ...OPTIONS, locale: 'vi-VN' })).toBe('05/11/2026');
+      expect(formatValue(new Date(NOV_5), 'date', OPTIONS)).toBe('11/05/2026');
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the calendar day of a date whatever the zone of the grid is', () => {
+      const late = new Date(NOV_5 + 23 * 3_600_000);
+      expect(formatValue(late, 'date', { ...OPTIONS, timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' })).toBe(
+        '11/05/2026',
+      );
+      expect(formatValue(late, 'date', { ...OPTIONS, timeZone: 'America/Los_Angeles' })).toBe(
+        '11/05/2026',
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('applies the Intl options of the column to a date', () => {
+      const options = { dateStyle: 'medium' } as const;
+      expect(formatValue('2026-11-05', 'date', { ...OPTIONS, options })).toBe(
+        new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { ...options, timeZone: 'UTC' }).format(NOV_5),
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('writes a datetime in the zone of the grid', () => {
+      const instant = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 20, 30);
+      const short = { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' } as const;
+      const utc = formatValue(instant, 'datetime', OPTIONS);
+      const hcm = formatValue(instant, 'datetime', { ...OPTIONS, timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' });
+      expect(utc).toBe(
+        new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { ...short, timeZone: 'UTC' }).format(instant),
+      );
+      expect(hcm).toBe(
+        new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { ...short, timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' }).format(
+          instant,
+        ),
+      );
+      // 20:30 UTC is already the next day at UTC+7.
+      expect(hcm).not.toBe(utc);
+      expect(hcm).toContain('11/6/26');
+    });
+
+    it('lets the Intl options of a datetime column replace the two styles, and keeps the zone', () => {
+      const instant = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 20, 30);
+      const options = { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23' } as const;
+      expect(
+        formatValue(instant, 'datetime', { ...OPTIONS, timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', options }),
+      ).toBe(
+        new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { ...options, timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' }).format(
+          instant,
+        ),
+      );
+      // A zone named by the column's own options wins over the grid's.
+      expect(
+        formatValue(instant, 'datetime', {
+          ...OPTIONS,
+          timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
+          options: { ...options, timeZone: 'UTC' },
+        }),
+      ).toBe(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { ...options, timeZone: 'UTC' }).format(instant));
+    });
+
+    it('writes a boolean as the words it is given, for search and CSV to read', () => {
+      expect(formatValue(true, 'boolean', OPTIONS)).toBe('Yes');
+      expect(formatValue(false, 'boolean', OPTIONS)).toBe('No');
+      expect(formatValue(true, 'boolean', { ...OPTIONS, yes: 'Có', no: 'Không' })).toBe('Có');
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('createTextCache', () => {
+    function column(id: string) {
+      return { id, text: vi.fn((row: { n: number }) => `${id}:${row.n}`) };
+    }
+
+    it('writes the text of a cell once per row object and column', () => {
+      const cache = createTextCache<{ n: number }>();
+      const a = column('a');
+      const row = { n: 1 };
+      expect(cache.text(row, a)).toBe('a:1');
+      expect(cache.text(row, a)).toBe('a:1');
+      expect(a.text).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('keeps a text apart per column and per row', () => {
+      const cache = createTextCache<{ n: number }>();
+      const a = column('a');
+      const b = column('b');
+      const first = { n: 1 };
+      const second = { n: 2 };
+      expect(cache.text(first, a)).toBe('a:1');
+      expect(cache.text(first, b)).toBe('b:1');
+      expect(cache.text(second, a)).toBe('a:2');
+      expect(a.text).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(b.text).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('writes the text again for a new row object, as immutable data asks', () => {
+      const cache = createTextCache<{ n: number }>();
+      const a = column('a');
+      cache.text({ n: 1 }, a);
+      cache.text({ n: 1 }, a);
+      expect(a.text).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    });
+
+    it('writes the text again for a new resolved column of the same id, since its locale may differ', () => {
+      const cache = createTextCache<{ n: number }>();
+      const row = { n: 1 };
+      expect(cache.text(row, { id: 'a', text: () => 'en' })).toBe('en');
+      expect(cache.text(row, { id: 'a', text: () => 'vi' })).toBe('vi');
+    });
+
+    it('gives the text of a row that cannot be remembered', () => {
+      const cache = createTextCache<number | null>();
+      const a = { id: 'a', text: vi.fn((row: number | null) => `a:${String(row)}`) };
+      expect(cache.text(5, a)).toBe('a:5');
+      expect(cache.text(null, a)).toBe('a:null');
+      expect(a.text).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    });
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/virtual.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/virtual.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5aa6828
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/virtual.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,207 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { computeOffsets, findWindow, splitWindow } from './virtual';
+import type { WindowPart } from './virtual';
+
+const uniform = (count: number, height = 10) => computeOffsets(count, () => height);
+
+describe('computeOffsets', () => {
+  it('holds the top of each row, and the total at the end', () => {
+    const heights = [10, 20, 30, 40];
+    const offsets = computeOffsets(4, (index) => heights[index]!);
+    expect(Array.from(offsets)).toEqual([0, 10, 30, 60, 100]);
+    expect(offsets).toBeInstanceOf(Float64Array);
+  });
+
+  it('is [0] for no rows', () => {
+    expect(Array.from(computeOffsets(0, () => 41))).toEqual([0]);
+  });
+
+  it('asks for each height once', () => {
+    let calls = 0;
+    computeOffsets(100, () => {
+      calls += 1;
+      return 41;
+    });
+    expect(calls).toBe(100);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('findWindow', () => {
+  const offsets = uniform(100);
+
+  it('finds the rows that meet the viewport', () => {
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 0, 35, 0)).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 4 });
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 25, 20, 0)).toEqual({ start: 2, end: 5 });
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out a row that only touches the viewport at an edge', () => {
+    // Row 2 ends at 30, where the viewport begins; row 4 begins at 40, where it ends.
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 30, 10, 0)).toEqual({ start: 3, end: 4 });
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 0, 40, 0)).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 4 });
+  });
+
+  it('widens the window by the overscan on each side, inside the list', () => {
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 250, 30, 3)).toEqual({ start: 22, end: 31 });
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 0, 35, 2)).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 6 });
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 950, 100, 3)).toEqual({ start: 92, end: 100 });
+  });
+
+  it('finds the last rows at the end of the list, and none beyond it', () => {
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 900, 100, 0)).toEqual({ start: 90, end: 100 });
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 5000, 100, 0)).toEqual({ start: 100, end: 100 });
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, 5000, 100, 2)).toEqual({ start: 98, end: 100 });
+  });
+
+  it('treats a scroll above the top as the top', () => {
+    expect(findWindow(offsets, -50, 35, 0)).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 4 });
+  });
+
+  it('follows rows of different heights', () => {
+    const heights = [50, 10, 10, 100, 10];
+    const mixed = computeOffsets(5, (index) => heights[index]!);
+    // 0-50, 50-60, 60-70, 70-170, 170-180
+    expect(findWindow(mixed, 55, 20, 0)).toEqual({ start: 1, end: 4 });
+    expect(findWindow(mixed, 100, 10, 0)).toEqual({ start: 3, end: 4 });
+  });
+
+  it('gives an empty window for no rows', () => {
+    expect(
+      findWindow(
+        computeOffsets(0, () => 10),
+        0,
+        100,
+        6,
+      ),
+    ).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 0 });
+  });
+
+  it('is found by binary search, not by walking the rows', () => {
+    const big = uniform(1_000_000);
+    let reads = 0;
+    const watched = new Proxy(big, {
+      get(target, property) {
+        if (typeof property === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(property)) reads += 1;
+        return Reflect.get(target, property);
+      },
+    });
+    // Row 500 000 starts at 5 000 000; the 800px viewport shows 80 rows.
+    expect(findWindow(watched, 5_000_000, 800, 6)).toEqual({ start: 499_994, end: 500_086 });
+    expect(reads).toBeLessThan(100);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('splitWindow', () => {
+  const offsets = uniform(100);
+  const spacer = (height: number): WindowPart => ({ kind: 'spacer', height });
+  const rows = (start: number, end: number): WindowPart => ({ kind: 'rows', start, end });
+
+  it('puts a spacer above and below the rows of the window', () => {
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 })).toEqual([
+      spacer(100),
+      rows(10, 20),
+      spacer(800),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('has no spacer where the window touches an end of the list', () => {
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 0, end: 20 })).toEqual([rows(0, 20), spacer(800)]);
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 80, end: 100 })).toEqual([spacer(800), rows(80, 100)]);
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 0, end: 100 })).toEqual([rows(0, 100)]);
+  });
+
+  it('draws the kept row at its own place when it is above the window', () => {
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, 3)).toEqual([
+      spacer(30),
+      rows(3, 4),
+      spacer(60),
+      rows(10, 20),
+      spacer(800),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('draws the kept row at its own place when it is below the window', () => {
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, 90)).toEqual([
+      spacer(100),
+      rows(10, 20),
+      spacer(700),
+      rows(90, 91),
+      spacer(90),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('joins the kept row to the window when they are next to each other, and at the ends', () => {
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, 9)).toEqual([
+      spacer(90),
+      rows(9, 20),
+      spacer(800),
+    ]);
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, 20)).toEqual([
+      spacer(100),
+      rows(10, 21),
+      spacer(790),
+    ]);
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, 0)).toEqual([
+      rows(0, 1),
+      spacer(90),
+      rows(10, 20),
+      spacer(800),
+    ]);
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, 99)).toEqual([
+      spacer(100),
+      rows(10, 20),
+      spacer(790),
+      rows(99, 100),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves the window alone when the kept row is inside it or is not a row', () => {
+    const plain = splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 });
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, 15)).toEqual(plain);
+    for (const keep of [-1, 100, 250, 3.5, Number.NaN, undefined]) {
+      expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 10, end: 20 }, keep)).toEqual(plain);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('holds the whole height in one spacer when the window is empty', () => {
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 0, end: 0 })).toEqual([spacer(1000)]);
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 100, end: 100 })).toEqual([spacer(1000)]);
+    expect(splitWindow(offsets, { start: 100, end: 100 }, 40)).toEqual([
+      spacer(400),
+      rows(40, 41),
+      spacer(590),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives no part for no rows', () => {
+    expect(
+      splitWindow(
+        computeOffsets(0, () => 10),
+        { start: 0, end: 0 },
+      ),
+    ).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('never makes a spacer of no height, and the parts add up to the whole list', () => {
+    for (const [start, end, keep] of [
+      [0, 20, 20],
+      [0, 20, 21],
+      [50, 60, 0],
+      [50, 60, 99],
+      [0, 100, 50],
+      [30, 30, 29],
+    ] as const) {
+      const parts = splitWindow(offsets, { start, end }, keep);
+      let total = 0;
+      for (const part of parts) {
+        if (part.kind === 'spacer') {
+          expect(part.height).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+          total += part.height;
+        } else {
+          expect(part.end).toBeGreaterThan(part.start);
+          total += offsets[part.end]! - offsets[part.start]!;
+        }
+      }
+      expect(total).toBe(1000);
+    }
+  });
+});
